        backtest_page = BacktestPage(page)

        bots_api = BotsApi()
        toast_message = "Backtest was successfully created"

            first_name_bot = response['items'][0]['name']
            bot_id = response['items'][0]['id']
            bots_page.click_bot_card(first_name_bot)
    
        with allure.step("Click on backtest tab"):
            bot_details_page.click_on_page_tab('backtest')
    
        with allure.step("Run a backtest"):
            bot_details_page.click_run_new_backtest_btn()
